messages:
maya: Heads-up — new pilot needs mixed GPU quota in asia-northeast1. Requesting regional increases under project `redwood-inference-pilot`:
  - A100 (v4): +16
  - H100: +8
  - L4: +40
  Also need 50 ephemeral external IPs for burst pools and VPC peering egress bumped to 6 Gbps.

adrian: Can you confirm the exact project id and the service account used for provisioning? I need that for the GCP support form. Also do we have a billing commit for this pilot?

maya: Project id is `redwood-inference-pilot`. SA is `infra-provisioner@redwood-inference-pilot.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. No long-term commit — pilot will run ~6 weeks, but we expect sustained usage during business hours.

vivian: Quick cost note: rough estimate for steady-state (L4 serving + occasional H100 evals) is ~USD 25k/month if full pop. If we only burst H100 for eval windows cost spikes but average drops. Added `CO-42` as cost center in the request.

ton y: @adrian we need the request to include NAT IP quota justification. GCP sometimes rejects EIP-only asks without explaining NAT vs reserved routing. Can you add the sentence: "ephemeral external IPs required for scaled burst pools to attach to pre-provisioned host EIPs for predictable routing and firewall rules"?

adrian: Yup. I'll update the narrative. Draft for support form:
```
We are onboarding a pilot customer that will run mixed workloads across A100, H100, and L4 instances. The requested increase supports a staged rollout with reserved burst pools and controlled external IP allocation. Project: redwood-inference-pilot. Service account infra-provisioner@redwood-inference-pilot.iam.gserviceaccount.com. Cost center: CO-42. Expected start: 2026-04-06. Please approve A100:16, H100:8, L4:40, External IPs:50, VPC Peering Egress:6Gbps.
```

infra-bot: Quota request submitted to GCP case 987654321. Status: PENDING. Reference ID: gcp-case-987654321. (automated)

costbot: Estimated incremental monthly spend at max allocation: A100:$10,400 | H100:$6,400 | L4:$8,200 | EIPs+egress:$350. Total ~ $25,350. (model: on-demand rates)

maya: Thanks — added sample `gcloud` command to provisioning notes for infra-runbook:
```
gcloud compute instances create example-a100 --accelerator=type=nvidia-a100,count=1 --project=redwood-inference-pilot --zone=asia-northeast1-a
```

adrian: I'm going to approve this internally pending finance sign-off. @tony please confirm CO-42 is ok. If yes I'll escalate the GCP case and request expedited review.

ton y: CO-42 is fine from my side. :thumbsup: Please tag the case with "business-critical:pilot" and set escalation to P2.

vivian: One more ask — set up a temporary alert on cost burn and per-region GPU utilization so we can cap bursts automatically. I can add a dashboard and a policy with budget alerts.

maya: Done — created a dashboard prototype and budget alert (threshold 60% of forecasted spend). Sharing link in #eng-sre after this thread.

infra-bot: GCP case 987654321 updated: Escalation requested (P2). Next update expected within 4 business hours.

adrian: Great — I'll follow up once GCP responds. Thanks all.
